scope: Read-only audit of first-behavior reference helper, actual parent creator and VM harness bridge; optional readonly runtime/build injection checked for context. No repository writes, formal test edits, protocol changes or full test rerun.

previousPureReview.result: Previously reviewed independent strict WeakMap brand, origin, descriptor, source-range and scalar budget boundary; reused as evidence without rerunning its 6 tests.

verifiedBoundaries.conclusion: Owner identity includes session/catalog/source/binding/instance/backend/language/epoch/readEpoch plus world/base and all four scene provenance fields. Owner changes reset the generation and replace DOM closures. Observed pending or content changes permanently revoke an in-flight operation. Parent switching captures and retains each binding fragment, then refreshes the helper.

Each effective fill first rereads the same explicit scene/assembly; captures through the new first-creation brand; compares origin, selected assembly and complete frozen directory fingerprint; then rechecks owner, full raw JSON, all selections and DOM values before proposing and before callback.

Read and selection never call parent mutation. Same semantic String value preserves the exact escaped token and does not call parent onUse. Pure fragment-budget error preserves JSON, current directory and reviewed transaction. A real accepted text change performs parent guarded capture, updates raw/display state, invalidates preview and requires ordinary review again.

Output is ordinary parameter draft text only. Final creation retains strict identity-only planning, applySceneBehaviorCreateParameterSources for every binding and existing behavior.create preview/apply receipt validation. No reference-specific relation, hidden write, saved-source manifest or runtime permission is introduced.

Runtime exposes a separate read-only function guarded by live exact-true sceneBehaviorReferences capability. The saved behavior source host is not reused. The shared raw DTO is independently recaptured and branded against first-creation provenance; no saved-manifest brand is manufactured or borrowed.

The bridge transports origin and raw directory own-data records into the imported helper realm, preserving parent session/catalog/source owner identities. It never constructs a reference brand or grants host writes. Prototype normalization is fixture-only: formal malicious-prototype proofs remain the pure actual boundary tests, and this VM probe does not claim to replace Chrome.

cases: Real parent pending fill across two binding selections and back cannot revive detached controls or alter either raw fragment/review.
Real parent cancel+new creator owner rejects previous pending fill, retaining new owner text and its approved review.
Real observed profile switch away and back permanently revokes pending fill even after another successful ordinary review.
Two-binding aggregate at exactly 32768 B is refused by ordinary final review before any command when a small valid fragment replacement grows the aggregate.
independentProbes.formalTests: The current 22 UI and 5 transport declarations were read, not rerun; these 4 independent probes are not a replacement formal total.

observation.status: 参数 JSON 须为有效的标量对象，参数名、数值与数量须符合行为限制。

aggregateBudgetBoundary.conclusion: Pure proposal checks the selected fragment in a single-binding skeleton. It cannot know every other local binding. A valid growing fragment can therefore be accepted and revoke review before a combined manifest overflow is discovered by the ordinary parent review. Persistence is correctly blocked before command dispatch. Current unchanged-input guarantees apply when lookup/proposal itself fails or returns a no-op; they must not be described as every possible combined-parent validation running before insertion.
aggregateBudgetBoundary.optionalFollowup: If product acceptance requires an aggregate overflow to leave the former draft/review intact at fill time as well, preflight the proposed fragment through the existing identity planner and full all-binding apply in parent onUse before any textarea mutation. This is a UX scope decision, not a bypass of final validation.

diagnosticFirstAttempt.explanation: Diagnostic budget fixture initially totaled only 32596 B, so a 36-character replacement remained valid. The fourth probe expectation was wrong; after raising the other binding padding from 3000 to 3200 and binary-searching the final valid boundary, actual original manifest was exactly 32768 B. No product source changed. The first attempt is preserved and is not counted as a pass.

limitations: No real Chrome or Godot run was added in this read-only audit.
Hypothetical injected controller implementation or forged trusted getContext objects are not the deployed trust boundary.
